name: Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd
summary: Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the urban renewal business in Israel. The company was formerly known as Cannomed Medical Cannabis Industries Ltd and changed its name to Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd in January 2023. Geffen Residence & Renewal Ltd was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Ashdod, Israel.
